timeline.text: My AI screened every LinkedIn posting with one generic prompt — and let scores above 70 slip past missing degrees and experience gaps.
A junior role needing a degree, a manager role needing a master's — both scored high anyway; the language check only caught exact phrases.
So a Groq model now reports language, paid years, and education as structured facts, not a soft opinion.
Code then applies hard caps from those facts — missing degree, wrong language, years that don't add up.
Postings that used to score seventy or higher now score zero.
